neighbours.label: token ' lips' after 'to his' or 'to her' (bringing something to the mouth)
fire: He raised the glass up to his lips and drank.
She brought the cup slowly to her lips.
The old man lifted the flute to his lips.
He kissed her hand and raised it to his lips.
She pressed a finger to her lips for silence.
He held the spoon to his lips and blew.
The girl lifted the whistle to her lips.
She put the bottle to her lips at once.
quiet: He raised the glass up to the light and smiled.
She brought the cup slowly to the table.
The old man lifted the flute to the shelf.
He took her hand and raised it to the sky.
She pressed a finger to the door for balance.
He held the spoon to the fire and waited.
The girl lifted the whistle to the window.
She put the bottle to the side at once.

notes: A broad-looking pole: ' to', ' up', ' +' and 'version' are on the card and not covered. ' compensate' reached 0.33 in a probe.
